notes.title: Time for Steam!
notes.notes:
Get ready for a challenge that will rattle your bones! 🧟‍♂️🔥 On 6 November, 'Escape Z' arrives on Steam and drags you into a fast-paced, co-operative zombie apocalypse. Face hordes of undead together with your friends in a fight for survival that will test your skill and strategy!

[b][h2]Add the game to your wishlist so you don't miss out on the news to come![/h2][/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2571140/Escape_Z/

[h3]See you on 6 November![/h3]

notes.title: [Announcement] 1 week to game release

Get ready to take to the field, in 1 week, [b]on December 17th at 17:00 GMT[/b], the game will be released worldwide.

[b]Tell your friends and add the game to your wish list.[/b]

Don't be caught unprepared.
